content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for District Court Bilaspur Various Posts Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: https://districts.ecourts.gov.in/bilaspur. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 12-08-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for District Court Bilaspur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application for the District Court Bilaspur Recruitment 2026 is 12 August 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Shorthand Typist Grade-3 (Hindi) posts?
faq.answer: There are 12 vacancies available for the Shorthand Typist Grade-3 (Hindi) post in the District Court Bilaspur Recruitment 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the minimum age requirement for the posts?
faq.answer: The minimum age requirement for all the posts is 18 years.

faq.question: Q4. What is the maximum age limit for the posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all the posts is 30 years, with age relaxation applicable for reserved categories.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for the District Court Bilaspur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is no application fee mentioned for any category in the official notification for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for the Vehicle Driver post?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Vehicle Driver post includes a Written Test, Interview, Document Verification, and Merit List preparation.

faq.question: Q7. What is the educational qualification required for Assistant Grade-3 Cadre?
faq.answer: Candidates must be Graduates from a recognized university and possess a one-year Diploma in Computer from a recognized board/university.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any relaxation in the upper age limit?
faq.answer: Yes, age relaxation is provided for SC/ST/OBC candidates (5 years), women residents of CG (10 years), and ex-servicemen/Govt employees (5 years).

faq.question: Q9. What is the salary for Shorthand Typist Grade-3 (Hindi) post?
faq.answer: The salary for the Shorthand Typist Grade-3 (Hindi) post ranges from Rs. 28700 to Rs. 91300 per month.

faq.question: Q10. How should candidates submit their applications?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted offline by sending the filled form along with required documents to the address specified in the official notification before the last date.
